title: Preserve authored tempo visibility where GP8 supports it
scope: Resolve the legacy HideTempo export gap independently from tempo interpolation and event annotations.
acceptance: Demonstrate visible and hidden opening tempo marks with the same fractional BPM.
Determine whether GPIF Visible and the pinned consumer can represent HideTempo without suppressing tempo playback.
Implement verified preservation or retain a scoped target limit, with independent and strict-policy evidence.
exclusions: Automation interpolation and occurrence semantics belong to automation-detail.

reproduction.instructions: Demonstrate visible and hidden opening tempo marks with the same fractional BPM.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
